title: Streamlined model intake heuristics for enterprise requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: enterprise customers are submitting varied model onboarding requests (new model adds, version pinning, deprecations) with inconsistent information, making prioritization slow and error-prone. Goal: create a lightweight but deterministic intake + scoring heuristic and a gated onboarding checklist that triages enterprise requests into: auto-approve (low-risk, supported), PM review (business impact / strategic), and escalated (security/regulatory or high-risk quality regressions). This ticket scopes the PM-driven rubric, required intake fields, and the acceptance criteria for an initial pilot that will run with two enterprise pilot customers. Deliverables: intake form schema, scoring matrix with cutoffs, list of automatic triggers for security/KMS/region review, and a minimum viable eval gate definition that can be automated against the catalog eval harness.
proposed_workflow:
1) New enterprise intake (form + API) captures required metadata: dataset residency, PII risk, latency SLOs, expected QPS, model family and weights origin, requested pinning window, and requested deprecation date.
2) Heuristic scorer assigns weights across dimensions (business priority, customer revenue potential, technical fit, compliance risk, evaluation risk).
3) Score thresholds: <= 10 auto-accept to onboarding queue; 11-30 PM review required; >=31 escalate to Security/Legal and Research.
4) For PM-review cases, attach a one-pager template and required eval checklist (regression prompts, fairness checks, perf targets).
5) For escalations, block until security sign-off and a dedicated research evaluation is complete.
6) Triage outcomes are recorded to the catalog metadata and surfaced in the Console (per-request trace).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form schema implemented in the self-serve portal and exposed via API
Scoring matrix documented and implemented as an automated step in the intake workflow
Eval gate: minimum automated tests (latency smoke, generation quality on canonical prompt set, safety classifier pass) run and pass for all auto-accepts
Escalation triggers defined and a documented path to Security/Legal/Research with SLA for review
UI: request details and triage result visible in Console request audit and model catalog entry
A pilot run is completed with two enterprise customers and feedback captured
decision_log: 2026-03-10: Kickoff with PM, Eng, Research. Agreed to pilot with two existing enterprise customers and start with minimal eval gate (smoke + safety classifier).
2026-03-11: Design feedback: intake form must avoid free-text for region/residency; use controlled vocabulary to drive automated routing.

2026-03-12: Eng constraints: automated scoring must be stored as part of model catalog metadata to enable routing in runtime. Agreed to a v1 implementation using a lightweight scoring service (ENG-4233) rather than full workflow engine.
2026-03-13: PM decision: score thresholds tuned to prioritize compliance-first for enterprise requests; auto-accept reserved for low-risk OSS models with no residency/PII constraints.
notes: Trade-offs: a conservative scoring matrix reduces operational risk but increases PM workload; aim for 2-week pilot to validate thresholds.
Follow-up: build a small feedback channel for enterprise SEs to flag false-positives in triage results.
Operational: telemetry events for each intake should emit: request_id, score, reason_codes, assigned_queue, and reviewer if applicable.
